version: F11_PROPOSED dialogue SC08–49 (DRAFT) — completes the full-film dialogue (with the opening SC01–07)
status: DRAFT — NOT accepted. F10 frozen & unchanged. Globally-intelligible English; Björn-led; canon-continuous. Scenes with 0 beats (SC25/45/46/47) are action/visual — no dialogue by design.

lines.speaker: WIDOWER
lines.en: I keep his place. Someone should, when the water forgets a man.

lines.speaker: SETH-NAKHT
lines.en: The sky split the day they fell into it. That is not chance. That is a debt.

lines.speaker: ELDER
lines.en: And debts, commander, are always paid by someone.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: You carry a storm in you, big one. But you can't read the one outside.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: I read men by how they fall.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: Men, yes. Not tides. Not time.

lines.speaker: OLAF
lines.en: Listen to him, Björn. I'm out of answers.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: The girl, though — she already listens to the water.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: This wall remembers every time the two ages touched.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: And every time, someone died to close it.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: Someone who could read it. Who walked in — and did not walk out.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: ...Then pray it isn't the girl.

lines.speaker: SETH-NAKHT
lines.en: You'll read me a road to the seam-root, or the river takes this town street by street.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: Force the tear and both ages bleed. You cannot command a wound, commander.

lines.speaker: SETH-NAKHT
lines.en: I can command who bleeds for it. Meryt — you'll see it done.

lines.speaker: MERYT
lines.en: ...Yes, commander.

lines.speaker: BÖRK
lines.en: Sit. Eat. You can't break a cage by glaring at it, big man.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: I can break the man who built it.

lines.speaker: BÖRK
lines.en: After supper. — Vigge, more fire, less staring.

lines.speaker: TOVE
lines.en: Börk's found a kitchen in a prison. We're saved.

lines.speaker: OLAF
lines.en: They're yours now, Björn. All of them.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: You're not dead yet, kinsman.

lines.speaker: OLAF
lines.en: Near enough. Hear me — your arms won't carry them out of this one.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Then what will?

lines.speaker: OLAF
lines.en: Her. The one who reads the water. Trust her when it makes no sense.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: ...I don't even trust it myself yet.

lines.speaker: SETH-NAKHT
lines.en: You walk my readers to the seam-root. The old man keeps breathing only as long as you're useful.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: And if I say no?

lines.speaker: SETH-NAKHT
lines.en: Then the water says it for you. Tonight. To the town.

lines.speaker: OLAF
lines.en: Take it, Björn.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: ...We walk. For now.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: Don't fight the ground. Read it. What is the water about to do?

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: STAY DOWN!

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: It doesn't take orders, Björn. It takes attention.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: There. Left. Now — feel it?

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: ...I felt it. One breath early. Just one.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: Everyone off the low road — the tide's coming up through the wells!

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Move them! I've got the jam!

lines.speaker: BÖRK
lines.en: Saving the stew-pot! A man has priorities!

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Norse and river-guard. One band. One road.

lines.speaker: TOVE
lines.en: They drill like dancers.

lines.speaker: MERYT
lines.en: You fight like a dropped cart.

lines.speaker: HELGI
lines.en: ...She's got you, Tove.

lines.speaker: TOVE
lines.en: You trust her. The reader-girl.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: I trust that she's right.

lines.speaker: TOVE
lines.en: Not the same thing.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: No. — Tove. If the sword can't win this, I don't know what I am.

lines.speaker: TOVE
lines.en: You're the one who keeps us standing while she says where to stand. That'll do.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: ...I'll pay for that.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: Pay later. Count the exits now.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: The east row — clear it — the water comes THERE!

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Through me! GO!

lines.speaker: SETH-NAKHT
lines.en: My town thanks its commander for the warning.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Your town watched a Norse girl call the sea and a Norse back hold the stone. They know whose warning it was.

lines.speaker: SETH-NAKHT
lines.en: ...Careful, big one.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: That's not from here. That's from... before. Or after.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: The ages are leaking into each other. It's faster now.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Then we move faster.

lines.speaker: SETH-NAKHT
lines.en: The old man rides with me now. March — and he keeps breathing.

lines.speaker: MERYT
lines.en: You lost someone to the water too. I can see it on you.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: My brother. The storm. I couldn't reach him.

lines.speaker: MERYT
lines.en: I didn't lose mine to the water. I tried to call mine back from it. That's worse.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Tell me.

lines.speaker: MERYT
lines.en: The dawn-rite is lit once. I lit it twice — for my drowned brother. Forbidden.

lines.speaker: MERYT
lines.en: The suns touched. The sky tore. Every corner the sea has taken since — I opened that door.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: You grieved. That's not a crime.

lines.speaker: MERYT
lines.en: It is here. And the debt is still owed.

lines.speaker: HELGI
lines.en: There's two kinds of carrying a thing, Björn. Out of duty — or because you chose it.

lines.speaker: HELGI
lines.en: You've only ever done the first kind. The nod. The order.

lines.speaker: HELGI
lines.en: Learn the second before the day you need it. Don't learn it too late.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Hold the line! Don't chase — let the ground do the work!

lines.speaker: TOVE
lines.en: Two down for the big man! Three! — tasteful footwork!

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Tove.

lines.speaker: TOVE
lines.en: Counting's a sacred art.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: He fights quieter than he used to. Good.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: Hear that? The root is close. The stone answers readers now.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: The causeway floods in threes — on the third, RUN!

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: I've got the rope! Cross me!

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: Björn — don't look at the water. Look at me!

lines.speaker: OLAF
lines.en: ...Not far now, Björn.

lines.speaker: TOVE
lines.en: He says that every day. Either he's lying, or we're immortal. I'll take either.

lines.speaker: SETH-NAKHT
lines.en: Tell them, Meryt. Tell them whose grief drowned their neighbours.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: She told me already. It changes nothing you can use.

lines.speaker: IPU
lines.en: Is it true you broke the sky?

lines.speaker: MERYT
lines.en: ...I did.

lines.speaker: IPU
lines.en: Then you can fix it. You're the only one who knows where it's broken.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: At the convergence the door can be shut — from inside. Whoever reads it closed does not return.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: ...Understood.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: It begins. The two suns are drawing to one.

lines.speaker: SETH-NAKHT
lines.en: Then I take the root now, while there's still a door to own.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: You own nothing here. Form up! Readers behind me!

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: Björn — the whole field's about to move. Stay on my voice.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: Left of the cracked pillar — THREE — TWO —

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: On her word. Not mine.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: HOLD!

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: You taught them fear. She taught me what to fear. Different lesson.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: The door's open, commander. Die taking it from me — or help me shut it. Choose.

lines.speaker: BÖRK
lines.en: Vigge — UP! I've got the water — you've got the living!

lines.speaker: BÖRK
lines.en: Tell them... the stew was fine.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: It must be a reader who walks in, Björn. Astrid. Or me.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: Then it's me. I'm the strongest read left.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: No. I've been learning. One breath early — that's enough. It's enough.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: It should be me. I can read it cleaner —

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: And I can choose. Helgi taught me the difference. Let me choose this.

lines.speaker: OLAF
lines.en: You became more than a sword, kinsman. I lived to see it.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Rest, captain. I've got them.

lines.speaker: OLAF
lines.en: ...I know. That's why I can go.

lines.speaker: TOVE
lines.en: You never could fit through a normal door anyway.

lines.speaker: BJÖRN
lines.en: Keep them standing, Tove.

lines.speaker: TOVE
lines.en: ...Always did. Go on, big man.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: He could not read, once. He learned — to spend it on us.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: He chose it. He wanted me to know he chose it.

lines.speaker: MERYT
lines.en: The debt is paid. The sky is whole.

lines.speaker: NEFER-KA
lines.en: Set the sword in the stones. Let the river remember a Norseman who learned to listen.

lines.speaker: IPU
lines.en: ...and the stew, he said, was fine.

lines.speaker: ASTRID
lines.en: He really did say that.

lines.speaker: IPU
lines.en: Tell it again. From the storm.
